data.title: 久岛鸥 · 旧皮箱上的亲密约定
data.description: 在铺着厚绒毯的秘密基地内，巨大的复古皮箱被当成了临时桌榻。比基尼的系带被一根根解开，鸥双手支撑在箱体两角，仰起脖颈在接连不断的亲吻中娇声喘息。
data.location: secret wooden hideout decorated with ship ropes, nautical flags, and velvet rugs
data.action: arching back atop her open antique steamer trunk, loosened bikini straps falling away, crying out softly in sweet shuddering bliss
data.lighting: warm dust-mote beams streaming through secret knotholes highlighting bare curves
data.mood: whimsical treasure-chest passion, breathless maiden blossoming, unforgettable secret intimacy
data.promptProse: Arching her slender back atop her vintage trunk, Kamome gasps with parted lips as untied bikini strings fall away in golden hideout light.
data.animaCaption: Kamome surrendering atop her antique trunk, loosened bikini falling away in ecstasy.
